text.en:
Section one of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred and twenty-seven is amended to
read as follows:
"Section 1, All provinces, municipalities, municipal districts, and the cities of Zamboanga, Baguio, and Davao
shall be exempt from the payment of sheriff fees."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 7, 1941.
